The foreign transaction fee for a credit card is 3.0% of the amount, as stated in the fee schedule (fee_schedule#2). If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!
The policy could not be checked. Please consult the bank's fee schedule or contact customer support for detailed information on replacement fees.
The annual fee for a credit card is 300,000 VND, and it is waived when the spending is at least 50,000,000 VND per year (fee_schedule#1). For more details, you can refer to the fee schedule section.

The bank's interest rate on an unpaid credit card balance is outlined in the fee schedule section of the card terms. According to the policy, the interest rate is typically around 1.5% per month, compounded daily. For more specific details, please refer to the fee schedule section of your card's terms. (fee_schedule#2.3)

If your dispute about a payment you actually made is rejected, a handling fee of 80,000 VND applies, as stated in the fee schedule (fee_schedule#4.1). The bank will explain the reason for the rejection, and the provisional credit will be reversed with 5 working days' notice (dispute_policy#4.5).

You have 60 days from the payment date to report an unauthorized payment. If you report it within this period, you are not liable for the amount. For more details, refer to (dispute_policy#3.1) and (card_terms#4.2).

As per the policy, the bank refunds the amount as a provisional credit within 5 working days while it investigates an unauthorized payment. This applies unless the payment was confirmed with the customer's own OTP or biometric check. 

For more details, you can refer to (dispute_policy#4.2) and (faq#4).

The policy regarding the validity period of an OTP is not available in the provided documents. Please check the bank's official guidelines or contact customer support for detailed information.

After entering 5 wrong OTPs, the card's online payments will be paused for 30 minutes (authentication_rules#4.2). During this time, you cannot make any online payments. If you need to proceed, wait for the 30-minute period to expire and try again.

For a single transfer in the app, a biometric check is required for amounts of 10,000,000 VND or more (authentication_rules#2.1). If the total of the customer's transfers in one day exceeds 20,000,000 VND, a biometric check is also required (authentication_rules#2.2). Smaller transfers are confirmed with the app PIN or the device's own biometric unlock (Smart OTP) (authentication_rules#2.4).
